meta.title: South and Southeast Asian politics knowledge network, c. 1964-2026
meta.description: Key works and debates in the politics of South and Southeast Asia: Indian democracy and the party system, Hindu nationalism and the BJP, caste, ethnicity and quotas, communal violence, clientelism and vote buying, federalism and decentralization, military rule and civil-military relations in Pakistan, Bangladesh and beyond, insurgency and civil conflict, developmental states and the political economy of growth, authoritarian durability in Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam and Cambodia, Indonesian democratization, bossism, oligarchy and populism in the Philippines, monarchy and coups in Thailand, Myanmar's military and transition, religion and Islam, corruption and bureaucratic accountability, democratic backsliding, and ASEAN and great-power competition. Works shared with the other maps are imported from them; others are top-cited 2006-2026 articles selected via Crossref (area-studies and political science journals) and anchoring books and classics. Direction: source (later or dependent work) -> target (earlier or anchoring work).

edge_types.builds_on: source extends or relies on target's argument or evidence
edge_types.challenges: source contests target's claim, mechanism or evidence
edge_types.qualifies: source adds a scope condition or moderating factor to target
edge_types.extends_to_new_case: source applies target's logic to a new population, period or domain
edge_types.synthesizes: source integrates target with other work
edge_types.mechanism_tested_by: source tests a mechanism implied by target

meta.verification: Repo works come from the user's Zotero library. Works imported from the other maps keep their verification. Crossref-selected works take title, authors, year, venue and DOI from Crossref records. Anchors are checked in Crossref separately; see each node's `verified` field. One-line claims for non-repo works are my summaries.
